biggest_catch: No retroactive referrals: the new member MUST name you during the application process at account opening, or no bonus is ever paid - and rewards are processed only after 90 days from membership opening.
catches: The referred member must be new to Premier (no current or prior Premier membership, including as joint owner or co-borrower) and must name the referrer during the application process; retroactive referrals are not accepted.

New member must complete ONE qualifying path within 90 days: open a qualifying personal checking account + enroll in Digital Banking and eStatements + receive two direct deposits of $250+; OR fund a qualifying Premier loan of $10,000+.
Both members must be 18+ and in good standing at payout.
Total referral payouts capped at $599.99 per member per calendar year (combined referrer/new-member payouts); Premier may also make a $50 charitable donation per qualifying referral.
Rewards processed after 90 days from membership open date; if the new member does not qualify within 90 days, no incentive is paid; may be reported to the IRS; Premier employees/Board not eligible.
